integrity: The central result is an analytic Pauli-commutation calculation. A deterministic finite-dimensional checker verifies the star commutators and the explicit two-edge chain overlap, but the checker is only a consistency test and is not used as proof of the general statement.
limitations: The result proves a mandatory commutation quotient and complete order blindness for the two star families. It does not classify all further degeneracies from exceptional weights, global phases, or state-dependent coincidences.
title: Edge order survives only modulo Pauli commutation in RZZY hypergraph states
